title: WildClaiming
body:
# WildClaiming - Claiming System for Paper and Folia

A sleek, modern, and GUI-driven land protection plugin designed to give players full control over their builds while keeping the server experience seamless and grief-free.

Whether you run a survival SMP or a competitive community server, **WildClaiming** bridges the gap between powerful administration and intuitive player management.

---

## 🚀 Key Features

* **Visual Claim Boundaries:** No more guessing where your land ends. WildClaiming uses customizable blocks (like Froglights) and vibrant particle effects to show exactly where a claim is located.
* **Fully GUI-Driven Dashboard:** Players can manage their entire claim through an elegant, multi-page inventory menu—no messy multi-line commands required for everyday settings.
* **Granular Role System:** Protect your assets by assigning distinct roles to your friends:
* **Owner:** Full control over the land, transfers, and deletion.
* **Members (Trust):** High-tier access (open containers, manage armor stands, etc.).
* **Helpers (Add):** Low-tier access (interact with doors/buttons, break/place blocks).


* **Extensive Flag System:** Toggle over 30+ unique toggles per claim, including PvP, Mob Spawning, TNT/Creeper Damage, Fluid Flow, Crop Trampling, Weather/Time locks, and entry restrictions!
* **Playtime Block Rewards:** Reward active players by giving them additional claim blocks automatically for every interval they spend online.
* **Robust Database Integration:** Support for both lightweight **SQLite** storage and high-performance **MariaDB/MySQL** networks.
* **Admin Inactivity Cleanup:** Easily track down abandoned or inactive claims through a dedicated admin GUI to keep your game world clean.

---

## 🛠️ Commands & Subcommands

WildClaiming features a highly organized, modular command system (`/claim` or aliases like `/claims`, `/claiming`, `/wildclaiming`).

### Player Commands

* `/claim` – Opens the main menu or dashboard of the claim you are standing in.
* `/claim create` – Claims the area selected with your claim tool.
* `/claim delete` – Abandons the current claim and returns your blocks.
* `/claim description <text>` – Sets a custom description for your claim info menu.
* `/claim expand <amount>` – Expands the claim by a specified number of blocks in the direction you are facing.
* `/claim give <player>` – Triggers a secure, irreversible transfer of ownership to another player.
* `/claim info` – Displays detailed information about the current area (ID, owner, size, active members).
* `/claim list` – Opens a paginated GUI displaying all claims you own or have access to.
* `/claim flags` – Directly opens the flag configuration matrix for the claim.
* `/claim show` – Toggles the visibility of the claim borders and particle grids.
* `/claim access` – Opens a management screen for trusted players and helpers.
* `/claim sendblocks <player> <amount>` – Gifts some of your claim blocks to another player.

### Moderation & Punish Subcommands

* `/claim kick <player>` – Kicks an unwanted intruder out of your claim boundary.
* `/claim kickall` – Forcibly removes all non-trusted players from your claim area.
* `/claim ban <player>` – Bans a player from stepping foot inside your claim.
* `/claim banall` – Blacklists all players currently not explicitly trusted.
* `/claim unban <player>` – Removes a player from your claim's ban list.
* `/claim unbanall` – Clears your claim's ban list completely.

### Admin Commands (`/claim admin <subcommand>`)

* `/claim admin bypass` – Toggles Admin Bypass mode to modify or manage any claim on the server.
* `/claim admin claimblocks <add/remove/set> <player> <amount>` – Manages player claim block balances directly.
* `/claim admin deleteall <player>` – Deletes all claims belonging to a specific player.
* `/claim admin findabandoned` – Opens the dedicated GUI listing claims belonging to inactive players.
* `/claim admin list <player>` – Lists all claims registered to a specific player.
* `/claim admin tp <id>` – Teleports directly to the specified claim ID destination.
* `/claim admin transfer <id> <player>` – Forcibly transfers a specific claim ID to a new player.
* `/claimadmin reload` – Safely reloads all plugin configurations, flag defaults, database hooks, and translations.

---

## 🔒 Protect Anything (The Flag List)

Every claim owner can fine-tune their land dynamics using the intuitive flag matrix GUI. Available flags include:

* **Environment:** `Fluid Flow`, `Fire Spread`, `Leaf Decay`, `Gravity`, `Ice/Snow Formation`, `Ice Melting`.
* **Interactions:** `Buttons & Levers`, `Pressure Plates`, `Doors & Gates`, `Armor Stands`, `Villager Trading`, `Lecterns`.
* **Combat & Spawning:** `PvP`, `Mob Spawning`, `Kill Animals`, `Kill Monsters`, `Kill Villagers`.
* **Cosmetics & Fun:** `Player Time Lock` (Day/Night/Noon), `Player Weather Lock`, `Biome Simulation` (changes grass colors inside the claim), `Custom Enter/Exit Titles` & Actionbar messages.

---

## 🔑 Permissions Nodes

### Player Permissions

Granted by default (`default: true`) unless explicitly revoked:

* `claimsystem.command.*` – Grants access to all base player subcommands.
* Individual nodes: `create`, `delete`, `info`, `list`, `show`, `kick`, `kickall`, `ban`, `banall`, `unban`, `unbanall`, `expand`, `sendblocks`, `give`, `access`.



### Management & Protection Flags

Allows players to interact with specific flag configurations inside their claims (`default: true`):

* `claimsystem.flag.*` – Allows toggling all flags (*Defaults to OP*).
* Individual flag access nodes:
* `claimsystem.flag.fluid_flow` | `claimsystem.flag.fire_spread` | `claimsystem.flag.tnt_damage`
* `claimsystem.flag.leaf_decay` | `claimsystem.flag.crop_trample` | `claimsystem.flag.block_smelt`
* `claimsystem.flag.coral_death` | `claimsystem.flag.crop_grow` | `claimsystem.flag.snow_form`
* `claimsystem.flag.ice_form` | `claimsystem.flag.pvp` | `claimsystem.flag.mob_spawning`
* `claimsystem.flag.block_homes` | `claimsystem.flag.player_no_enter` | `claimsystem.flag.teleportation`
* `claimsystem.flag.player_time` | `claimsystem.flag.player_weather`
* `claimsystem.flag.enter_actionbar` | `claimsystem.flag.exit_actionbar`



### Administrator Permissions

* `claimsystem.admin.bypass` – Grants Admin Bypass mode to override protection boundaries everywhere.
* `claimsystem.admin.manage` – Allows administrators to view, modify, and delete foreign claims via administration GUIs.

---

## 🧩 PlaceholderAPI Support

WildClaiming offers native integration with **PlaceholderAPI** to easily display claim data across scoreboards, chat formatters, or tab lists.

| Placeholder | Description | Output Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `%claimsystem_claimblocks%` | Displays the player's remaining usable claim blocks. | `1450` |
| `%claimsystem_owner%` | Displays the name of the claim owner at the player's location. | `JustGino` / `Unclaimed` |
